bio.text: Ralph Alvarado, a Republican physician, is a candidate for Kentucky's 6th Congressional District in 2026, having launched his campaign in July 2025.
He served eight years in the Kentucky Senate and was later appointed Commissioner of the Tennessee Department of Health.
He was Matt Bevin's running mate in the 2019 Kentucky gubernatorial election and, per a campaign press release, spent three decades as a physician in central Kentucky.

sources.title: Alvarado announces campaign for congressional seat
